title: Wasserstein Flow Matching: Generative Modeling Over Families of Distributions
tldr_zh: 把 FM 提升到 Wasserstein 空间，样本本身是分布，Gaussian 用闭式 BW 路径、点云用 entropic OT 估计
tldr_en: Lifts flow matching to Wasserstein space over distributions, using closed-form Bures-Wasserstein paths for Gaussians and entropic OT for point clouds
